Shell(node -e " // Reuse the classifier logic to sanity-check against expected mappings const CENTRAL = ['railway', 'ssc', 'psu', 'banking', 'upsc', 'ibps', 'sbi', 'rbi', 'central', 'rrb', 'defence', 'defense', 'navy', 'army', 'air force', 'capf', 'cpo', 'cgl', 'chsl', 'mts', 'ntpc', 'lic', 'fci']; const STATE = ['state', 'psc', 'state wise', 'statewise', 'tnpsc', 'appsc', 'kpsc', 'uppsc', 'mppsc', 'bpsc', 'rpsc', 'hpsc', 'spsc', 'wbcs', 'ppsc', 'gpsc', 'mpsc', 'jpsc', 'cgpsc', 'apspsc']; function classify(name) { const n = String(name || '').toLowerCase().trim(); if (!n) return 'none'; for (const t of CENTRAL) if (n.includes(t)) return 'central'; for (const t of STATE) if (n.includes(t)) return 'state'; return 'none'; } const cases = [ // [input, expected] ['Railway', 'central'], ['SSC CGL', 'central'], ['PSU', 'central'], ['RRB NTPC', 'central'], ['UPSC', 'central'], ['Banking', 'central'], ['IBPS PO', 'central'], ['State PSC', 'state'], ['TNPSC Group 1', 'state'], ['APPSC', 'state'], ['UPPSC', 'state'], ['State Wise Exams', 'state'], ['Current Affairs', 'none'], ['Mock Tests', 'none'], ['Quizzes', 'none'], ['', 'none'], [null, 'none'], [undefined, 'none'], ['Ministry of Railways (State Board)', 'central'], // 'railway' matched first ['State Bank of India', 'central'], // 'sbi' matched first (central) ]; let pass = 0, fail = 0; for (const [input, expected] of cases) { const got = classify(input); const ok = got === expected; if (ok) pass++; else fail++; console.log((ok ?
